descriptionUz: Taxminan 10 daqiqa. 12 ta qisqa savol — hozirgi darajangizni aniqlaş uçun. Bu test rasmiy imtihon emas.

exercises.question: She ___ to school every day.
exercises.explanationUz: Present Simple, uçinçi şaxs birlikda fe’lga -s qöşiladi.

exercises.text: There isn't ___ milk in the fridge.

accepted: i went to the library yesterday
yesterday i went to the library
exercises.explanationUz: Past Simple: “go” → “went”, vaqt sözi oxirga qöyiladi.

exercises.evidence: Anna is a waiter in a small cafe
exercises.passageExcerpt: Anna is a waiter in a small cafe near her house. She gets up at six and takes the bus to work.
exercises.explanationUz: Matnda u kafeda işlaşi aytilgan — şuning uçun False.

exercises.statement: Anna earns a lot of money.
exercises.passageExcerpt: Anna is a waiter in a small cafe near her house. She gets up at six and takes the bus to work.
exercises.explanationUz: Maoş haqida heç narsa aytilmagan — Not Given.

exercises.question: If the train had left on time, we ___ here now.
exercises.explanationUz: Aralaş (mixed) conditional: ötmiş şarti + hozirgi natija.

exercises.text: By this time next year, she ___ her degree.
exercises.explanationUz: Future Perfect: kelajakdagi belgilangan nuqtadan oldin tugagan harakat.

exercises.question: “The findings were largely inconclusive” — “largely” here means…

accepted: after i had finished reading the book, i closed it
having finished reading the book, i closed it
when i had finished reading the book, i closed it
exercises.explanationUz: Ikki ötmiş harakatidan oldinroq bölgani uçun Past Simple (yoki Perfect participle).
